description: This file declares function prototypes for the Content Filtering Authentication Message Management Object (CfAmmo). It includes creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions, and appears intended for use as an exported API in a C project related to content filtering. It contains macro guards, function prototypes, and licensing comments.

methods.name: CfAmmoComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates a component instance of the Content Filtering Authentication Message Management Object with provided context handles.

methods.name: CfAmmoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Content Filtering Authentication Message Management Object with provided context handles.

methods.name: CfAmmoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deletes the specified CfAmmo object instance.

methods.name: CfAmmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary objects within the CfAmmo instance.
